title: Hash Chaining Layer Extension v0.1
description: Optional Layer 4 extension adding previous_hash field for tuple accountability chains.

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous tuple in the chain. null or absent if this is the first tuple.

args_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of tool call arguments, for replay verification.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the tuple content (excluding integrity fields).
